response.sql: WITH c AS (SELECT p.birth_country AS country, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_college pc JOIN player p ON pc.player_id = p.player_id GROUP BY p.birth_country), s AS (SELECT country, tally, CAST(tally AS REAL) / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share, AVG(tally) OVER () AS avg_tally FROM c) SELECT SUM(tally) AS combined_tally, AVG(share) AS avg_share, AVG(tally - avg_tally) AS avg_excess_over_avg_tally FROM s WHERE tally > avg_tally
